narr: A stationary boundary was situated from west to east across northern OH on July 12th, 2021, and would lift north to Lake Erie by late afternoon. This allowed for a warm, unstable airmass to reside over the region, with surface dewpoints in the low 70s, and PWAT values in the 1.8 to 1.9 range. MLCAPE values were near 1000 j/kg, with slow storm motions in the 20 to 25 kt. range. Deep layer bulk shear was generally less than 30 kts. An initial cluster of thunderstorms developed and moved northeast across eastern Lorain, western Medina, and southern Cuyahoga counties during the morning hours, dropping a swath of 0.50 to 2.00 of rainfall. Additional storms developed in the warm sector late afternoon and moved northeast across the region, dropping an additional 0.50 to 2.25 of rainfall, which caused the flash flooding in areas with repeated rainfall due to storm total rainfall of 1.75 to 4.00.
ev: Widespread flooding with road closures in Valley City and Brunswick Hills. Flooding on Boston Road near Boone Road due to a swollen tributary leading into the Rocky River. Center Road and Marks Road closed due to flooding. Numerous reports of basement flooding. Approximately 15 roadways were closed in Medina County due to flooding in the vicinity of Valley City.
Numerous road closures in and near Plum Creek near Columbia Station due to flooding. Some areas across roads and yards had at least 3 ft. of standing water.

Widespread flooding through the northern half of the county. Hewins Road in Windham Township has 6 ft. of water across the roadway. Three mobile home parks in Ravenna Township were inundated. Over 20 homes in Ravenna Township had basement flooding, with additional flooding reported throughout Nelson Township, Garrettsville, and Freedom Township.
